title: Fix duplicate retention continuations for Waiting jobs
summary: Retention policy continuation scheduling now detects Waiting jobs to prevent duplicate continuations when the dispatcher moves a job to Waiting status, checking for existing Waiting work before creating or restarting continuations.
key_points: Check for Waiting continuations before selecting Ready or On Hold jobs to prevent duplicates
Use IsEmpty() for efficient Waiting job detection without materializing records
Waiting work takes priority in scheduling decisions
Internal scheduling helper returns whether a create or restart actually occurred
Six new test cases cover duplicate prevention and priority scenarios
quote: Once the dispatcher moved an existing continuation to Waiting, another limit-exceeded notification could create a duplicate.
